page.notes: The Hebrew forms and vowel points are read from a heavily blotted scan and are doubtful throughout; the root letters are the most reliable part. Several Hebrew forms in the right column (אבדל, אברהל, אבו) are uncertain. The header line above the first column is largely illegible, and the running head is only partly visible. A faint stamp and show-through in the lower left have been left out. The date and page number do not appear on the scan.
